content.value_statement: Writing clear professional emails takes time and tone choices can slow busy teams. This skill drafts structured messages for requests, follow-ups, updates, apologies, and customer replies.
actual_capabilities: Drafts email structures with subject, greeting, context, body, call to action, sign-off, and name.
Provides templates for requests, follow-ups, technical updates, support replies, meeting requests, apologies, declines, and announcements.
Adapts tone for formal, casual, urgent, and professional contexts.
Suggests clear subject lines for actions, reports, schedule changes, and quick questions.
Applies etiquette checks for clarity, recipients, attachments, urgency, and calls to action.
limitations: It does not send emails or connect to an inbox.
It depends on user-provided context for names, dates, deadlines, and facts.
It does not verify business claims, order status, or technical incidents.
It cannot guarantee legal, compliance, or brand approval for sensitive messages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer Replies
use_cases.description: Draft clear support responses that acknowledge the issue, explain actions taken, and set expectations.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Project Work
use_cases.description: Create requests, follow-ups, meeting invitations, and status updates with organized next steps.

use_cases.title: Share Technical Notices
use_cases.description: Write maintenance notices and technical updates that explain impact, timing, and required actions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a professional email to [recipient] about [topic]. Include [key points]. Use a [tone] tone and end with [desired action].

prompt_templates.title: Write a Follow-Up
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a prior message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a follow-up email about [previous topic]. Mention that I sent the original message on [date]. Restate [main points] and ask for [next step].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Technical Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a technical update for [audience]. Cover the change, timing, expected impact, user action, rollback plan, and contact path.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Tone and Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this email for [recipient type]. Make it [tone], reduce ambiguity, keep facts unchanged, and flag any claims that need verification: [draft].

output_examples.input: Request a Q4 project timeline update from a colleague in a friendly tone.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Question about the Q4 project timeline

Hi Maya,

I hope your week is going well. Could you share the latest update on the Q4 launch timeline? It would help us plan marketing work and confirm any dependencies.

Thanks for your help,
Jordan

output_examples.input: Notify a team about an API maintenance window with two hours of downtime.
output_examples.output:
Subject: API maintenance window on Thursday

Team,

We will perform scheduled API maintenance on Thursday from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM UTC. During this window, API endpoints may be unavailable. Please notify users, confirm retry logic, and monitor your services after maintenance.

Thanks,
Alex

output_examples.input: Apologize to a customer for an order issue and explain next steps.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Apology and update on your order

Hi Priya,

I am sorry for the issue with your order. We corrected the shipping address and issued a replacement today. You should receive tracking details within 24 hours. Please reply if anything still looks incorrect.

Best regards,
Customer Support

best_practices: Provide the recipient, purpose, key points, desired tone, and expected action.
Ask for a subject line and body together, then review both before sending.
Verify dates, names, links, claims, and attachments before using the draft.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent facts, approvals, order details, or incident timelines.
Do not use urgent language unless the deadline and impact are real.
Do not send sensitive legal, financial, or HR messages without expert review.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails for me?
faq.answer: No. It drafts email text only. You must review and send messages through your own email tool.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, recipient relationship, key points, tone, deadline, and desired next step.

faq.question: Can it write technical updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for API maintenance notices, downtime messages, and team updates.

faq.question: Can it help with customer support replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft replies that acknowledge issues, explain actions, and set clear expectations.

faq.question: Does it support different tones?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports formal, casual, urgent, and professional tones based on your request.

faq.question: Should I verify the final email?
faq.answer: Yes. Check facts, recipients, links, attachments, and approvals before sending any message.
